verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents a bearer-token REST API whose global token is described as valid for managing anything within Better Stack. The pack also shows full create/update/delete endpoints for monitors, plus Terraform and an MCP server for programmatic and LLM access. However, only monitor endpoints are concretely evidenced, and no published OpenAPI spec was found, so UI-to-API parity across incidents, on-call schedules, escalation policies and status pages is implied rather than shown. Missing for 10: documented API coverage for on-call schedules, escalation policies, status pages and incidents; an explicit UI/API parity statement; a machine-readable OpenAPI spec; independent corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: A global API token is a token valid across all your teams, for managing anything within Better Stack.
